headline: Bank Of America, Goldman Sachs, Citi Join Push to Launch Global Stablecoin
summary: Wall Street giants including Bank of America, Goldman Sachs and Citi are joining a 21-firm consortium targeting a global, regulated dollar stablecoin launch in the first half of 2027.

headline: AI Is Speeding Up Private Credit — JPMorgan Expert Wonders Who'll Spot Its Mistakes
summary: Artificial intelligence could give private credit investors an earlier warning when borrowers begin to deteriorate, according to JPMorgan.
